description: Find PixilUI animated icons (132, free, based on Hugeicons) for a job: "copy", "send", "approval", "tokens". Returns each icon's component, import, install command, what it means and the hooks that move it (hover, data-state values, aria-expanded or aria-pressed, data-working), plus the bundles. Filter by bundle or group, by a data-state, or by whether it loops while working.

group.description: A bundle (icons-everyday, icons-ai-jobs, icons-ai-actions, icons-ai-tools) or a group name.

limit.description: How many icons to return; default 20.

query.description: What the icon is for, in a few words. Leave empty to list.

state.description: Only icons that play this data-state, for example copied, running, done.

working.description: Only icons that loop (true) or do not loop (false) while work runs.

name: find_icons
title: Find animated icons
